sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
✷ RICE WATER CONDITIONING SHAMPOO.

✧ Wet your hair thoroughly.

✧ Apply rice water conditioning shampoo to the scalp and hair.

✧ Gently massage for a few minutes.

✧ Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

--------------------------------------------------

 ✷ OVERNIGHT HAIR GROWTH MIST.

✧ Generously spray the Overnight Hair Growth Mist onto dry or slightly damp hair.

✧ Gently massage the Mist into your scalp and hair.

✧ Tie your hair in a loose bun or use a silk scarf to avoid transfer onto your pillow.

✧ Let the Mist work its magic as you sleep, and wash your hair in the morning as part of your routine.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Xtreme Hair Growth Combo – Stronger Roots, Healthier Growth, Real Results

If your hair feels weak, dull, or you’re dealing with constant hair fall, it’s time to switch to a routine that actually supports your scalp and roots. The Xtreme Hair Growth Combo is built to give your hair consistent care using a powerful blend of fermented rice and Ayurvedic ingredients.

This combo works on multiple levels—supporting hair growth, controlling hair fall, and strengthening weak follicles. Fermented rice is known for improving hair texture and promoting natural growth, while ingredients like coffee, bhringraj, and amla help reduce breakage and support healthier roots. Keratin and almond oil further strengthen the hair structure, making your strands smoother and more resilient.

With regular use, your hair feels stronger, looks fuller, and becomes easier to manage without heavy or greasy buildup.

Why You'll Love It 😍

• 
Fermented Rice Formula – Supports natural hair growth and improves texture

• 
Hairfall Control Blend – Coffee, bhringraj, amla, and argan oil help reduce breakage

• 
Stronger Hair Follicles – Keratin and almond oil support root strength and resilience

• 
Nourishing Ayurvedic Base – Aloe vera, neem, and natural oils help maintain scalp health

• 
Lightweight Routine – Easy to use, non-sticky, and suitable for regular application

Stay consistent with your routine—because stronger, healthier hair is built over time, not overnight.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Can I use the shampoo daily?

No — use it once a week or as and when you get scalp build-up. Its potent formula is designed for weekly scalp detox.

Q2. Can the mist be used on oily scalp?

Yes, it is lightweight and absorbs quickly, suitable for all scalp types, including all-type of scalps.

Q3. How long until I see results?

Most users experience reduced hair fall in 2–3 weeks and visible baby hair in 4–6 weeks with consistent use.

Q4. Can men and women both use it?

Absolutely — the combo is unisex and effective for all.

Q5. Is it safe for colored or treated hair?

Yes, both products are gentle and safe for chemically treated hair.
